title: I09 Destination Farm Reception & Welfare Assessment
description: Arrival event and condition on arrival, each animal categorised fit, unfit or dead in line with Reg (EC) No 1/2005; injuries are assessed within "unfit". Carries the UC-4 anomaly reporting — there is no separate mortality or injury credential.

x-traced.issuer: Keeper at the place of destination (Art. 8(2); Annex II, point 4 and Section 3). At a slaughterhouse, the official veterinarian's controls remain a separate official control and are referenced, not replaced.
x-traced.holder: Keeper at destination; shared with the transporter and the authorities.
